name: Event — Bulletin
summary: Dense schedule layout for multi-session programmes: solid header band, then a scannable time / title / speaker table.

palette.note: Header band uses --flyer-field / --flyer-field-ink; the schedule body sits on the gradient and uses --flyer-ink.

slots.name: kicker
slots.label: Kicker
slots.help: Spaced caps above the title, e.g. "Weekend Seminar".

slots.name: subtitle
slots.label: Dates / location
slots.help: Said once here so it does not have to repeat in every row.

slots.name: sessions
slots.label: Sessions
slots.help: Nine rows is the comfortable ceiling at these sizes. Past that, split the programme across two flyers rather than shrinking the type.

slots.name: note
slots.label: Footnote
slots.help: Childcare, meals, registration — the small print.

slots.name: cta
slots.label: Call to action (phone number)
slots.help: Ask which number to use — the events/RSVP line is not the food-order line.
